edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in _safeMint.
msg.sender must equal the owner and receives the withdrawn balance.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing to _msgSender().
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing to _msgSender().
claim requires the sender to be the owner of each token index.
transferFrom skips the allowance check when msg.sender is the Masks contract.
changeName requires the caller to be the owner of the token.
getNFTPrice gating depends on block.timestamp versus SALE_START_TIMESTAMP.
mintNFT branches on block.timestamp versus REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to flag pre-reveal mints.
claim requires block.timestamp to be after emissionStart and records it as last claim.
accumulated reward computation depends on block.timestamp relative to emission bounds.
getNFTPrice requires block.timestamp >= SALE_START_TIMESTAMP.
getNFTPrice requires totalSupply() < MAX_NFT_SUPPLY.
mintNFT enforces supply caps against MAX_NFT_SUPPLY.
mintNFT compares block.timestamp against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
mintNFT checks and writes startingIndexBlock.
finalizeStartingIndex requires startingIndexBlock to be set and hashes it.
finalizeStartingIndex reads and writes startingIndex.
changeName uses _nctAddress for the NCT token payment.
The NCT transferFrom target address comes from _nctAddress.
setNameChangePrice writes the nameChangePrice state variable.
withdraw is restricted to _owner.
renounceOwnership clears and checks _owner.
transferOwnership writes and checks _owner.
isApprovedForAll queries the OpenSea proxy registry at proxyRegistryAddress.
accumulated uses emissionStart as the default last claim baseline.
accumulated clamps accumulation to emissionEnd.
accumulated multiplies elapsed time by emissionPerDay.
claim updates _lastClaim for each claimed token index.
claim uses _masksAddress to verify token ownership and supply.
accumulated calls the Masks contract at _masksAddress.
setMasksAddress writes _masksAddress once.
transferFrom compares msg.sender to _masksAddress to skip approval.
claim computes the fee using the fee variable.
setFee writes the fee state variable.
claim mints the fee portion to feeTo.
setFeeTo writes the feeTo state variable.
mintNFT calls getNFTPrice to validate msg.value.
mintNFT calls _safeMint for each requested token.
mintNFT flow reaches the external receiver callback via _safeMint before completing.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external call to the recipient.
finalizeStartingIndex derives randomness from blockhash.
changeName performs an external NCT transferFrom before updating name state.
withdraw forwards ETH to msg.sender via transfer.
claim calls accumulated for each token index.
claim computes totalClaimQty - claimFee with an unchecked subtraction.
numberOfNfts parameter drives the minting loop in mintNFT.
tokenId parameter selects the token renamed in changeName.
newName parameter is validated and stored in changeName.
_nameChangePrice parameter is written to nameChangePrice.
tokenIndices parameter is iterated over in claim.
currentSupply local caches totalSupply in getNFTPrice branches.
totalClaimQty local accumulates claim amounts in claim.
balance local holds the ETH amount transferred in withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: The mint count parameter is only meaningful as an argument to the mintNFT entry point.
The token id parameter is only used inside changeName for ownership and name lookups.
The new name parameter is validated and stored exclusively by changeName.
The price parameter is written to state only by the setNameChangePrice setter.
The index array parameter is iterated over only in the claim function.
The cached supply local exists only inside getNFTPrice for price tiering.
The accumulator local is produced and consumed solely within claim.
The balance local is only used to transfer funds out in withdraw.
